structured_summary: The robot announces the package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery via speech within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: What happens if the user does not acknowledge within 8 seconds (timeout behavior, robot retry or abort).
What constitutes a valid acknowledgment (specific phrase, any speech).
What the robot should do if it fails to announce the delivery.
Speech modality details such as language, volume, or tone.
potential_ambiguities: Whether 'acknowledge' requires a specific verbal response or any utterance.
Whether the robot should repeat the announcement if no acknowledgment is received.
What the final confirmation entails (e.g., same phrase as announcement or a distinct message).
